stages.budget_scope: 30 epochs / 4096 patches / logical batch 8 / 20 evaluation repeats, matching the original SlotSPE defaults (utils/process_args.py --max_epochs 30 --num_patches 4096). Patch subsets are resampled every epoch and short bags are zero-padded rather than excluding the patient, reproducing third_party/SlotSPE/dataset/dataset_survival.py lines 285-292.

stages.purpose: One unified BLCA fold0/seed3 eleven-arm matched diagnostic; no automatic five-fold or multi-seed expansion. Current three-epoch preset is for short diagnosis, not full efficacy evidence.

matched_protocol: Same eligible patients, split hashes, real-patch cache/order, train-fold-only survival bins and preprocessing
Same seed-specific initial core/probe weights, data batches and paired RNG within each batching protocol
All eleven arms share this queue per-example compact protocol; S0 is trained once and reused only within this exact matched protocol
Same survival/auxiliary/reconstruction objectives plus explicitly itemized experimental losses
Fixed checkpoint/evaluation rule, same repeated-evaluation seeds; no best-seed selection
Store all private features, identifiers, weights, raw predictions and per-case arrays only under ignored local_evidence

slot_geometry: If active K<2, cosine is N/A with coverage and single-slot count; never substitute zero
Compare per-patient means, not a pooled pair mean that upweights high-K patients
content: Own versus donor content probe error with fixed probe capacity
Same-noise changed-input response and same-input changed-noise response
Input-independent dictionary control; state its information privilege and target construction
objectives: Separate added penalties and their gradient scales
Patient survival risk/predictions and repeated C-index under one protocol

decision_boundary: This user-selected queue includes all eleven methods at one BLCA fold. It supports a matched local diagnostic/screen only; do not claim cross-fold generalization or expand scope automatically. Content uncertainty remains a measured outcome, not a reason to silently omit selected arms.
patient_target_contract: Implemented: train-fold-only WSI/pathway mean and standard deviation; fixed type-specific random projections to 32 dimensions; deterministic per-case cluster sets up to eight. Same query-free probe architecture and detached probe update budget. Rectangular Hungarian matching plus nearest coverage costs for unmatched targets and slots, normalized by max(K,T); no padding, copied slots or discarded targets. This target differs from historical homogeneous generated targets.

requested_scope.fold_seed_choice: Retain the existing fold0/seed3 setting; user limited scope to one BLCA fold.
requested_scope.budget_status: Existing 3-epoch/256-real-patch diagnostic preset retained; a full-training budget was not newly specified.

shared_batching_protocol.all_selected_arms: per-example compact forwarding; identical seed-to-example schedule for every arm
shared_batching_protocol.auxiliary_loss: mean of native per-example auxiliary losses
shared_batching_protocol.main_loss: native survival NLL over concatenated per-example logits divided by logical batch size
shared_batching_protocol.added_losses: prediction-path first WSI/OMIC outputs per example, aggregated once per logical batch; native OMIC reconstruction reuse stays unchanged
shared_batching_protocol.optimizer_steps: one core update and the same probe-update budget per logical batch across all eleven arms; never one core update per patient
shared_batching_protocol.native_stochastic_calls: Reset the native root RNG independently for each example using the same predeclared seed schedule in all arms; S5 variable K must not change the next example RNG. Paired call order includes WSI/OMIC/reconstruction.
shared_batching_protocol.variable_slot_content_contract: Implemented coverage_set_mse: rectangular Hungarian matching with coverage costs for every unmatched target and slot, divided by max(K,T); equal-K agrees with matched_set_mse. Same probe and target construction for all selected arms; K<2 geometry is N/A.
shared_batching_protocol.patient_equal_reduction: Average slot-pair regularizers within each patient first, then average patients and modalities; variable K must not reweight patients by number of slot pairs.

preconditions: Audit diagnostic outputs including failures and content uncertainty
Lock eligible variants, budgets, splits, metric aggregation and checkpoint rule before final evaluation
out_of_scope_stages.interpretation: Use paired fold/seed differences; one fold and stochastic repeats are not independent generalization evidence. Low cosine alone does not authorize expansion.
out_of_scope_stages.reason: User requested only one BLCA fold to save time; not scheduled and no automatic promotion.

feature_contract.format: Existing .pt or .h5 features; HDF5 features must be [N,D] or [1,N,D]. Preparation hashes sampled private caches and records actual dimensions; no new encoding.
feature_contract.boundary: Encoder origin is a server provenance requirement; shape checks alone cannot certify UNI2-h. Generated validation uses explicitly invented random features and never certifies this dataset.

pin_revision_note.change: CUDA context is now explicitly initialised before torch.cuda.reset_peak_memory_stats.
pin_revision_note.reason: On the RTX 5090 the first eleven-arm patient run failed in arm S0 with RuntimeError: Invalid device argument at redundancy_engine.run_arm. reset_peak_memory_stats requires an existing CUDA context; redundancy_engine called it before any CUDA allocation, whereas patient.py only worked because an unrelated earlier get_device_name call happened to create the context. The fix makes the peak-memory baseline reset explicit and order-independent.
pin_revision_note.patient_behaviour_unchanged: Only the peak-memory counter reset path changed. No model, loss, RNG, batching, evaluation seed, checkpoint selection or metric logic was modified.
